# Gamescope-rs Micro-Compositor

> Valve Gamescope in pure Rust 2024 & WebGPU with AMD FidelityFX FSR 1.0 EASU & RCAS compute shaders.

## Canonical Resources

- Web Demo: https://aphrody.com/gamescope
- Shaders: https://aphrody.com/gamescope/shaders/
- WASM Engine: https://aphrody.com/gamescope/gamescope_web_wasm.wasm
